name: Split-flap & flip-dot board
doc: Transforms the input media into a kinetic architectural split-flap and magnetic flip-dot arrival board whose mechanical tiles cascade and flip into the picture in sync with the beat.

luma.doc: media brightness mask (core-media.luma) driving dot size and pigment brightness

edges.doc: media edge gradient (core-media.edges) triggering crisp onset flap chatter

palette.doc: station-board pigment palette for flip faces and transit accents

columns.doc: number of mechanical flap columns across the board

style.doc: Solari split-flap cards, circular magnetic flip-dots, or hybrid dot-matrix flaps

wave_mode.doc: spatial cascade pattern of each beat flip wave

chatter.doc: onset mechanical flutter along media edges and high bands

color_mix.doc: 0 = pure station palette pigments, 1 = full source media colors

glow.doc: overhead architectural gallery lighting and dot illumination
